thread:
amy: Quick sync — SOC2 evidence export + audit-log retention tiering. We need launch criteria for Q3. Ping @raj @taylor
raj: quick q: do we keep full raw logs for 7 years or tier to compressed events after 90d?
taylor: customers + legal asked for immutable audit trail for 6 yrs, but that kills S3 costs
legal-sara: legal: default retention 7 yrs for regulated customers, but can be customer-configurable with legal-hold API. Need chain-of-custody and proof of non-repudiation.
jon: product: propose tiered model: hot (90d full fidelity), cold (compressed encrypted 90d-2yr), archive (hashed manifests + index for 6-7yr). Also add export snapshot API for audits.
amy: ok tradeoff. what about signing manifests with KMS vs HSM? we need key rotation policy and attestation records in launch criteria.
raj: technical constraints: per-request HSM signing impacts latency. alternative: periodic batch-sign manifests (daily) inside HSM and store detached sigs. That keeps runtime fast.
taylor: suggested MVP launch criteria: 1) per-tenant retention policy config (UI + API), 2) signed daily manifests in S3, 3) export snapshot endpoint, 4) audit-log export job with integrity checks, 5) SLA 99.9 for exports.
ops-bot: deploybot: created ticket INF-9924: "audit-export-tiering + manifest signing" assigned to @raj
amy: can we include sampling for low-value telemetry to reduce volume? e.g., keep full for auth/access events, sample perf traces after 30d.
legal-sara: sampling OK for telemetry, NOT for auth/access-control or permission changes. those must be full-fidelity. Also need legal-hold override that prevents deletion even if retention expired.
jon: customers are asking for immutable snapshots they can pull for auditors. We should support an "export snapshot" that includes manifests + signature + index. Must be download-friendly (gzip + checksums).
raj: implementation note:
```
S3 layout proposal:
/{tenant}/audit/YYYY/MM/DD/events.ndjson.gz
/{tenant}/audit/manifests/YYYY-MM-DD.manifest
/{tenant}/audit/manifests/YYYY-MM-DD.manifest.sig
```
amy: risks: key compromise, manifest replay, cost growth. Mitigations: HSM-backed signing, periodic key rotation, retention tiering defaults, and monthly restore tests to verify signatures.
taylor: OKR tie: compliance friction metric — reduce time to produce audit evidence to <24h. Proposed priority: P1 for enterprise regulated tier, P2 for self-serve.
jon: decision proposal (for today's sync): scope MVP = per-tenant retention controls, daily batch-signed manifests (HSM-backed), export snapshot endpoint, SLA 99.9 for export jobs. Defer per-event real-time HSM signing and full immutable blockstore to v2.
amy: action items: @raj prototype batch manifest signer + S3 layout (INF-9924), @taylor draft launch criteria & runbook, @legal-sara produce evidence acceptance checklist and legal-hold semantics, @jon prepare customer comms + FAQ.
raj: ack, I'll start prototype this week.
taylor: will draft the launch criteria doc and add acceptance tests.
legal-sara: I'll prepare checklist + sample subpoena response language.
audit-bot: auditbot: evidence-record created id=evidence-2026-08-18-01 linked INF-9924
amy: thanks all — i'll book a 30m follow-up Wed 10am to review prototype and acceptance checklist. :calendar:
